title: Low Level Benchmarking Framework for Memory, CPU and Execution Time in R
text: goal timemoir benchmark memory usage, CPU usage, execution time functions accurately profiled using traditional benchmarking tools. particularly useful profiling long-running memory-intensive operations, involving -memory analytics arrow duckdb. Unlike traditional profilers like Rprof() profmem, timemoir uses forked R process run function isolation, parent process monitors memory consumption via ps::ps_memory_info() proc.time(). ’s simple effective approach.

title: Low Level Benchmarking Framework for Memory, CPU and Execution Time in R
text: Memory Profiling: Tracks initial peak memory usage (start_mem, max_mem) CPU Usage: Measures user system CPU time Elapsed Time: Captures real execution time (proc.time) Error Handling: Catches reports errors without stopping benchmarking loop Repetition: Supports repeated benchmarking n runs per function ❗ Note: package works Unix. relies parallel package fork process.

title: Low Level Benchmarking Framework for Memory, CPU and Execution Time in R
text: Benchmarking tools like bench::mark() microbenchmark() powerful fast functions. ’re dealing : Queries stream data disk, duckdb::dbGetQuery() large tables, arrow::open_dataset() lazy evaluations, R functions unpredictable memory usage, …timemoir gives visibility ’s really happening — memory, CPU time.

title: Benchmark functions — timemoir
text: Executes function separate forked process monitors memory cpu usage real time function best used long running functions like arrow duckdb requests fit classic benchmarking methods like utils::Rprof profmem. memory extracted every interval sec ps::ps_memory_info start_mem measured just launching function. max_mem max measured mem forked child cpu times duration given proc.time

title: Benchmark functions — timemoir
Benchmark functions — timemoir
text: ... functions benchmark. verbose boolean. TRUE (default) print information messages. n integer. number time function must run (default 1) interval (default 0.1) sleep interval memory check sec

title: Benchmark functions — timemoir
text: tibble timemoir object one row per benchmarked function 7 columns: fname, function name (string). duration duration (sec) function NA function fails. error, error message function fails, NA otherwise. start_mem memory used function benchmark (KB). max_mem max used memory (KB). cpu_user user cpu used sec cpu_sys system cpu used sec error message "Process zombie" typically indicates process terminated exceeding allocated memory quota.
